name: Camp Finberg
description_short: YMCA summer day camp in Norton, MA, with camp hours 8:30am-4:00pm and optional before care (from 7:00am) and after care (until 5:30pm). Families can register for 2, 3, or 5 days per week; specialty camps are 5-day only.
refund_policy_summary: After May 31, a $25 change fee applies to any registration change, including changing weeks, cancelling, or switching camps. Change requests must be submitted at least two full weeks before the affected camp week. Deposits can be moved to other weeks. Downgrades and cancellations are handled manually by the Camp Registrar, not through the online account.
